title: Synthesis 23: C:contained-swimmers is met, wall-off controls show the self-made rings (not the written coupling) hold the cargo, and the coevbits chase is replicated and robust
summary: Since 09:31: the Marangoni rods meet C:contained-swimmers (audited, M qualified by rod length); wall-off controls on both nematic worlds drop cargo retention from 10-13x to 0.22-0.25 on the same bodies, so W is earned by the self-made ring as a kinetic barrier; nematic-cargo is established SIBWD (BD); c38's coevbits O results are established and replicated on fresh seeds, with robustness and RB-shadow calibration submitted; phoretic swim-then-divide stays rare; CIPS bodies need fuel but an inhibitor does not make them divide. Next: c40's turnover-driven CIPS division from noise for C:metabolic-cell, a Laplacian-only twin for the Marangoni rods, and the matching operator on emergent bodies.
